originality.rationale: The closest exact reflection result computes only reduced Lefschetz numbers, not the geometric fixed-point homotopy type. Its full RESULT.md proof was inspected: it describes the edge orbits but provides no acyclic-Morse classification of the terminally whiskered half-grid complexes. Explicit new perfect Morse matchings at each of five initial even widths verify the strict strengthening. The nonequivariant 2026 preprint supplies a public first source date; its full text was inaccessible, leaving an acknowledged originality risk. Searches for the graph, wedge ranks, fixed locus, and equivalent formulations identified no stronger covering record.
